children: Gold witnessed a collective drop on Sunday, September 27, according to Dahab Masr data at 3:19 PM.
The 24-karat price stood at EGP 7,130.96 for purchase and EGP 7,055.75 for sale.
Meanwhile, the 21-karat gold amounted to EGP 6,240.21 for buying and EGP 6,174.4 for selling.
The 18-karat gold recorded EGP 5,348.75 for buying and EGP 5,292.34 for selling.
A gold coin reached EGP 49,921 for purchase and EGP 49,395 for sale.
Globally, the international ounce totaled $4,286 for buying and $4,283 for selling.

title: ZAWYA: Gold prices in Egypt fall on September 27
